guides.title: YouTube downloader for Android, free and open source
guides.description: Download YouTube videos and Shorts on Android with Maglev. Paste a link, pick a quality, save. Free, open source, no ads, no account.
guides.answer: Maglev is a free, open source YouTube downloader for Android. Share or paste a YouTube video or Shorts link, and Maglev reads it with yt-dlp on your phone and shows up to 6 qualities. Pick one and it downloads, with pause and resume, into Download/Maglev. No ads, no account.
guides.stepsTitle: How to download a YouTube video on Android
steps: Install Maglev
Get the APK from [GitHub releases](https://github.com/Kaos599/Maglev/releases/latest), or add Maglev to Obtainium. Maglev needs Android 7 or later.
Share or paste the link
In the YouTube app, tap Share and choose Maglev. Or copy the link, open Maglev, tap + and paste it. Shorts links work the same way.
Pick a quality
Maglev reads the video on your phone with yt-dlp and shows up to 6 qualities. Tap the one you want.
Watch it download
The video downloads with pause and resume, and lands in Download/Maglev, where any file manager or video player finds it.

extra.heading: Or use the browser
body: Open YouTube in Maglev's own browser, long-press a video and choose Download. The browser blocks ads and trackers while you browse.
Maglev updates yt-dlp once a day on Wi-Fi, so it keeps up when YouTube changes. In Settings → Updates → Video sites you can turn this off or allow mobile data.

limits: Protected video can't be saved. Maglev never gets around DRM.
A video behind a sign-in, such as an age-gated or private one, may not download. Maglev says "needs sign-in" when that happens.
Maglev is not on Google Play. Install it from GitHub, Obtainium or another source listed on the home page.
faq: Is this YouTube downloader free?
Yes. Maglev is free, with no ads, no tracking and no account. It is open source under the GPL-3.0.
Is Maglev safe, and is it open source?

The source code is public on GitHub under the GPL-3.0, and release APKs are built by GitHub Actions and signed with one key. Download it only from the official [GitHub releases](https://github.com/Kaos599/Maglev/releases/latest) page or Obtainium.
What quality can I pick?
Maglev reads the video and shows up to 6 qualities. You pick one before the download starts. What is on offer depends on the video.
Can Maglev download YouTube Shorts?
Yes. Share or paste a Shorts link the same way as any YouTube link, then pick a quality.
Can it download private or age-restricted videos?
Not reliably. A video behind a sign-in may not download, and Maglev tells you it needs sign-in. Live streams and protected video can't be saved.
Where are the videos saved?
In the Download/Maglev folder on your phone, where any file manager can open them. You can choose another folder in Settings.
